product.name: Malaysian Thesis Institution System (MTIS)
product.one_liner: MTIS is an AI research guide that helps Malaysian diploma, degree, and postgraduate students identify novel research gaps and structure their thesis titles, objectives, and methodologies.
product.customer: Malaysian students and academic researchers (B2C) in Malaysia, via subscription.
product.problem: "I don't know what to research, or how to make my topic unique enough for a thesis." "My supervisor is always telling me to find a 'gap,' but I don't know where to look."
product.today: Manual literature reviews using Google Scholar, UTM Library, and OpenAlex; reliance on supervisory advice, which is often generalized.

roles.name: Owner
roles.what: Runs the business, pays for hosting/API costs, monitors usage and subscriptions

roles.name: Student / Researcher
roles.what: Signs in, runs research gap searches, saves and exports results

roles.name: Admin (add via "+ Add a role")
roles.what: Manages users, quotas, and abuse monitoring

features.name: Auth
features.what: Sign up / sign in with Google or email-password

acceptance.text: Given a new user, when they sign up with Google, then an account is created and they land on the dashboard within 5 seconds

features.name: Auth
features.what: Sign up / sign in with Google or email-password

features.name: Topic Search
features.what: Student enters a topic + MY/INT toggle; system fetches real papers from OpenAlex and UTM repository

acceptance.text: Given topic "e-wallet adoption SME Malaysia" with MY toggle on, when they search, then ≥10 real papers with titles, years, DOIs/URLs display within 30 seconds

features.name: Gap Analysis
features.what: AI analyzes fetched paper abstracts and lists research gaps with citations

acceptance.text: Given fetched papers, when gap analysis runs, then ≥3 gaps are shown and every gap cites ≥2 papers from the fetched set (no uncited claims)

features.name: Title Suggestions
features.what: AI generates 2–5 thesis titles (tajuk kajian) from identified gaps, EN/BM toggle

acceptance.text: Given gaps, when generating, then 2–5 titles appear, each traceable to a cited gap, in the selected language

features.name: Deep-Dive Search
features.what: On chosen title, fetches more specific papers and re-runs gap analysis

acceptance.text: Given a chosen title, when the student confirms, then a new refined paper set for that title is fetched and gap-analyzed

features.name: Objectives & Methodology
features.what: Generates objectives, research questions, and methodology draft for the chosen title

acceptance.text: Given a chosen title, when generation completes, then objectives, research questions, and a methodology outline display, each referencing the refined papers

features.name: Usage Quota
features.what: Limits free trial users to 3 generations/day; resets daily

features.name: Usage Quota
features.what: Limits free trial users to 3 generations/day; resets daily

acceptance.text: Given a free-trial user who has used 3 generations today, when they attempt a 4th, then they are blocked with an upgrade/wait message and quota resets after midnight

features.name: Project History
features.what: Saves each research session; user can reopen past projects

acceptance.text: Given a saved session, when the user opens History, then all previous searches, gaps, and titles reload exactly

features.name: Export to Word/PDF
features.what: Download full research pack (gaps, titles, objectives, methodology)

features.name: Subscription & Payment
features.what: Upgrade to paid plan after trial (online payment)

features.name: Subscription & Payment
features.what: Upgrade to paid plan after trial (online payment)

features.name: Citation Checker
features.what: Verifies every AI claim links to a real DOI/URL before display

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.what: View users, usage stats, active subscriptions

features.name: Plagiarism-style similarity scan
features.what: Compare suggested title against existing theses

features.name: Full-text PDF reading
features.what: AI reads entire papers, not just abstracts

integrations: OpenAlex API (paper search), Semantic Scholar API (backup search), UTM institutional repository scraper (Playwright), OpenAI API, DeepSeek API, Supabase Auth (Google sign-in)

top_three.title: Security
targets: Every input is validated on the server
Secrets live only in environment variables, never in code, logs or the browser
HTTPS only, secure cookies and CSRF protection
Rate limits on sign-in and on every public route
A dependency audit runs on every build (pip-audit or npm audit)
Reviewed against the OWASP Top 10 before launch
Prompt-injection tests: text from customers never changes the rules

top_three.title: Reliability
targets: Every error gives a clear message, and nothing is left half-saved
Calls to outside services time out and retry with back-off
Daily backups, restored once to prove they work
Payments and actions are idempotent: a retry never runs them twice
The AI release gate passes before every release

top_three.title: Performance
targets: p95 page load under 2 seconds on a phone over 4G
p95 API response under 500 ms, not counting AI calls
A database index for every list and search
An AI reply starts within 5 seconds, streamed or with progress shown

baseline.title: Availability
baseline.baseline: An uptime check with an alert

baseline.title: Scalability
baseline.baseline: No state kept in the app server's memory

baseline.title: Privacy and PDPA
baseline.baseline: A privacy notice, and no personal data in logs

baseline.title: Usability and accessibility
baseline.baseline: Works on a phone; error messages say what to do

baseline.title: Observability
baseline.baseline: One safe log line per request

baseline.title: Cost efficiency
baseline.baseline: Know the monthly bill before it arrives

frontend.why: Industry standard, vast community support, excellent for building complex, dynamic interfaces (which your multi-stage research process requires). Next.js provides server-side rendering, which helps performance.
